answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor escrow before it can trade. A newcomer with no history is treated like a hollow shell: it may observe but cannot take paid work until its stake has sat untouched through a full reputation cycle, like a seed buried under tundra. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand locked stakes plus the waiting time, while one honest agent pays once and earns the stake back.
